note: IP-neutral. Issue #269: a planet's party barge, a big sail barge floating over the sand that is one long party. These are the defaults every barge shares; a planet has one only if its own file (content/core/planets/<id>.json) has a "barge" block, which gives it a name, its boss, a home spot, and may override anything here. A band plays the planet's cantina club music on the top deck; the crowd dances on every deck, steerage included, and never stops: not when the boss is gone, not while it is driven. Buy it from the boss or beat him, and it is yours (WorldState flag barge_owned_<planet id>): take the helm and drive it, slowly, like a speeder. Read by src/systems/world/party_barge.gd.
name: the party barge

talk: {boss}: Welcome aboard {name}! Nobody stops dancing on MY barge.
{boss}: You want my barge? {price} credits. Or try and take it, little one.
{boss}: Hah! Look at you. Have a drink. Have three.
{boss}: The band never stops. I pay them extra to never stop.
lines.bought: {boss} snatches your credits and waddles below deck to keep partying. {name} is yours.
lines.boss_beaten: {boss} tumbles below deck, still laughing. {name} is yours.
lines.helm_locked: The helm is the boss's. Buy the barge or take it.
lines.at_helm: At the helm of {name}.  [W/S] Throttle   [A/D] Steer   [E] Let go
lines.let_go: You let go of the helm. The party goes on.
